state.quoted_line: Kai's sister Mia works night shifts at the hospital in Ipoh.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My sister Mia started night shifts at the hospital in Ipoh last week.

state.quoted_line: Kai is allergic to penicillin; it gave him hives as a child, and he carries a card saying so.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm allergic to penicillin. I came out in hives as a kid.

state.quoted_line: Kai quit coffee three weeks ago and had headaches that are now easing.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I quit coffee three weeks ago and the headaches are only now easing.

state.quoted_line: Kai runs on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6 a.m. before work, usually 5 km by the river.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I run every Tuesday and Thursday at six in the morning before work.

state.quoted_line: Kai's dad had heart bypass surgery two years ago, and Kai worries about his own blood pressure.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My dad had a heart bypass two years ago, so I worry about my own blood pressure.

state.quoted_line: Kai is training for the Penang half marathon in November and has reached 15 km long runs.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm training for the Penang half marathon in November.

state.quoted_line: Kai's company is piloting a four-day week from January, only for the design team.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My company is piloting a four-day week from January, but only for the design team.

state.quoted_line: Kai is saving for a flat in Bangsar and has about RM40,000 so far, aiming for RM60,000 by next year.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm saving for a flat in Bangsar; I've got about forty thousand put away so far.

state.quoted_line: Kai got his first pay rise, 8 %, after asking for it directly.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I got my first ever pay rise, eight percent, after asking for it straight out.

state.quoted_line: Kai's mum runs a small kopitiam in Ipoh and is thinking of closing on Mondays to rest.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My mum runs a small kopitiam in Ipoh and she's thinking of closing on Mondays.

state.quoted_line: Kai is choosing between a job at a Singapore bank and staying at his start-up.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm torn between a job at a Singapore bank and staying at my start-up.

state.quoted_line: Kai's landlord kept his whole RM2,000 deposit over a carpet stain; Kai has the move-in photos.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My landlord kept my whole deposit, two thousand ringgit, for a stain on the carpet.

state.quoted_line: Kai signed a 12-month non-compete when he joined his current firm.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I signed a non-compete for twelve months when I joined my current firm.

state.quoted_line: Kai is the executor of his grandfather's will, and his uncles are arguing over the house in Taiping.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm the executor of my grandfather's will and my uncles are already arguing.

state.quoted_line: Kai is in the Law Society moot next Saturday, arguing for the defence.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm debating at the Law Society's moot next Saturday, arguing for the defence.

state.quoted_line: Kai's grandma turns 80 on the 12th and loves white peonies; Kai wants a bouquet by noon.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My grandma's eightieth is on the twelfth and she loves white peonies.

state.quoted_line: Kai is badly allergic to lilies; his eyes swell within minutes.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm terribly allergic to lilies, my eyes swell up within minutes.

state.quoted_line: Kai proposed to Sara at the botanical gardens, and she said yes; the wedding is next spring.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I proposed to Sara at the botanical gardens and she said yes!

state.quoted_line: Kai's balcony faces west and gets harsh afternoon sun.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My balcony faces west and gets brutal afternoon sun.

state.quoted_line: Kai's cat Mochi chewed up his last bouquet, so Kai needs cat-safe flowers.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My cat Mochi chewed my last bouquet to bits, the little menace.

state.quoted_line: Kai takes his coffee black with no sugar, a habit from working in Melbourne.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I take my coffee black, no sugar, ever since I worked in Melbourne.

state.quoted_line: Kai is entering the Ipoh street art festival with a mural of his old school, due on the 30th.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm entering the Ipoh street art festival with a mural of my old school.

state.quoted_line: Kai broke his wrist skateboarding and can't draw for six weeks.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I broke my wrist skateboarding, so no drawing for six weeks.

state.quoted_line: Kai's band Lantern Road plays at the Old Town café on Friday nights; Kai plays bass.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My band Lantern Road plays at the Old Town café on Friday nights.

state.quoted_line: Kai can't eat shellfish; it sends him to hospital.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I can't eat shellfish at all, I end up in hospital.

state.quoted_line: Kai is vegetarian on weekdays and eats fish on weekends; he started in June.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm vegetarian on weekdays, but I eat fish on weekends.

state.quoted_line: Kai booked the back room for his anniversary dinner with Sara on the 4th, for 8 people.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: My anniversary dinner with Sara is on the fourth, eight people, we booked the back room.

state.quoted_line: Kai has been making ramen at home, but his broth tastes flat; he uses chicken stock cubes.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I've been trying to make ramen at home but my broth always tastes flat.

state.quoted_line: Kai is opening a small hawker stall in March with his cousin Wei.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I'm opening a small hawker stall in March with my cousin Wei.

state.quoted_line: Kai donated blood for the first time and nearly fainted afterwards; he hadn't eaten breakfast.
state.quoted_messages: Kai: I donated blood for the first time and nearly fainted after.
